The interior districts, however, are designed as one giant trap with a maze-like layout, deadends and ambush locations aiming to lure any enemy army into false confidence. In peaceful times, the residents spend their days in the many training grounds honing their skills, in the various monasteries meditating or in the workshops perfecting their craftsmanship of the various goods the Orders need.

§YAbu§!\nAbu is a major town that houses the greatest naval base in the Thousand Islands. The city's location is unrivalled on the subcontinent, being surrounded by multiple layers of smaller islands that break the strength of any storm long before they reach the city, thus providing safe heaven for any ship anchored in the harbours. Abu's industries are centred around the harbour, providing repairs for the ships, services for the sailors on leave and workshops crafting all the necessary supplies.

§YKita§!\nKita is the last city of the once mighty Kamalian people. Following the Oblivion Invasion, which happened in the closing centuries of the Merethic Era, most Kamali people fled from the scourged and frozen parts of Kamal to the only place unaffected by unholy corruption. Many Kamalians then decided to sail off to unknown lands, but still, some chose to stay and fight for their homeland, no matter how much time and effort this would require.

§YKamala§!\nThe city of Kamala is the most prominent settlement of the Dir-Kamal region. The city is almost exclusively filled with residential districts, houses upon houses tightly packed together both underground and in spikey towers. It is hard to imagine that in the closing centuries of the Merethic Era, in the exact place of Kamala, numerous hosts attempted to fruitlessly hold the incoming forces of the Oblivion, drenching the very soil with so much blood that even now the fields around Kamala blossom with only red petals.

§YJerbronheim§!\nJerbronheim was the first permanent settlement the Atmorans managed to establish in Akavir. Located next to a natural harbour, which protects the city from the worst sea storms and shielded by mountains from the north, the climate is milder than the usual frozen wastelands of Kamal. Fishing and forestry are the most important industries, but due to the extreme difficulty of resupplying from Atmora and the openly hostile native races, Jerbronheim developed into a self-reliant city, its workshops producing a surprising variety of goods.

§YJun-Kamal§!\nJun-Kamal is a massive fortress city built around a once active Oblivion portal. The city itself has been fortified to the extreme, with massive walls and watchtowers, ditches, maze-like districts and traps at every corner uniquely designed to both hold back potential invasion from the portal and from outside. Forges, armouries, barracks, regimental camps, and training grounds fill Jun-Kamal's districts to provide all the necessities needed by the large garrison it can hold.

§YBlack Pyramid§!\nThe Black Pyramid is an immense ziggurat whose triangular faces are etched with Daedric runes that pulse with malevolent power. These monoliths loom over the shattered remnants of cities dragged into Coldharbour, their foundations rumoured to be built from the very rubble of those once-proud streets. While many Black Pyramids house labyrinthine chambers, serving as temples, workshops, prisons, and training halls, some stand as seamless bastions with no visible entrance, daring any onlooker to question what lies within.

§YBlackreach Forest§!\nFar below Skyrim's surface lie immense caverns lit by the glow of towering mushrooms that pierce the darkness like alien jellyfish. Their broad, luminescent caps wash the stalagmites and pools below in rippling hues of teal and violet while thin, filament-like tendrils drift lazily through the still air. Faint motes of phosphorescent spores dance in the hush, and every footstep echoes across fungal fields that carpet the cavern floor in a soft, spongy carpet of pulsing light.

§YCold Wastes§!\nCold Wastes stretch out like a fog-shrouded marsh of shallow, ice-crusted pools set amid black, waterlogged soil. Gnarled, skeletal trees claw at a slate-grey sky while jagged stone spires and fractured rock shards pierce the mist in every direction.

§YWithered Forest§!\nWithered Forest is a cursed woodland of skeletal oaks rooted in cracked, ash-grey soil. A heavy hush hangs over the groves, broken only by the slow drip of unseen water or the faint scrape of brittle wood against stone. Every breath here tastes of decay, as if the forest itself waits is ever dying but would never die.

§YAzure Plains§!\nAzure Plains is an ethereal expanse of frost-blue grasses woven into pale, crystalline soil beneath a cloudless cobalt sky. Slender, skeletal trees rise here like silent sentinels between jagged, obsidian-like spires that pierce the low-lying mist.

§YChasm§!\nChasm is a bottomless canyon cleft into sheer obsidian cliffs, where hollow wind moans through unseen walls, while the distant drip of hidden waters. Occasional tremors send cascades of crystalline dust tumbling into the void, where their echoes are swallowed by the endless dark.

§YDread Massive§!\nThe Dread Massive is a sprawling wasteland of shattered rock and floating monoliths, torn from the earth and suspended beneath a bruised violet sky. Jagged stone platforms hover over an endless void, their cracked surfaces veined with molten light as electric-blue lightning cleaves the roiling clouds and a low, thunderous hum vibrates through the tempest.

§YHeathlands§!\nHeathlands rise in gentle, grass-clad hills that swell and dip like an ocean at rest. Scattered across these soft undulations stand solitary trees, stunted oaks, wind-shaped birches, and squat junipers, each one a silent sentinel against the sky. Their gnarled trunks twist from the turf, leaves trembling in the breeze, while low grasses ripple between them in shifting bands of gold and green.

§YMoorlands§!\nMoorlands are a windswept expanse of tawny tussocks and peat-stained hollows. Their gently rolling contours are interrupted by mirror-still bog pools that capture the sky's sombre grey. Scattered clumps of stunted birch and gorse cling to the soggy earth, their roots sunk deep into the spongy turf.

§YPlateau§!\nPlateau is a broad, flat-topped expanse of sun-bleached stone whose sheer cliffs plunge into swirling mists below. Wind-carved ledges and terraces descend in ragged tiers, where hardy grasses and twisted shrubs cling to fractured seams.

§YGonfalon Bay§!\nOn the southeast coast of High Isle, Gonfalon Bay sits along the gentle hills of the Sapphire Coast. The bay is well sheltered and serves as the main harbor of the island, marked by lighthouses on each side. The land around it is mostly open, while the docks and shipyards spread along the shore and strong walls guard the city itself.

§YAmenos§!\nOn the southwest coast of Amenos, this small port stands at the edge of the thick jungle. The bay's waters are rough and the land beyond the walls is wild and dangerous, with the settlement serving as the island's only safe harbor.

§YVastyr§!\nOn the south coast of Galen, Vastyr sits along a sheltered bay protected by bluffs and strong walls. The city serves as the main harbor and center of the island, with docks lining the coast and Castle Mornard overlooking the town. The surrounding land is open and green, covered in rolling grasslands that stretch across the southern reaches of the island.
